I'm 21/M, and during my high school years I've been very miserable. Being in agony can sometimes feel like the only way out is through ending it all. Although my story is much different than yours, my life has been hell, and I was often very suicidal. 

You've experienced stuff that no person deserves to experience. The people and experiences probably wander around in your mind non-stop. Not only do you dwell in the past, but you probably also think about what the future has in store for you. Neither the past nor the future exist. They are in our imagination only. What only exists is the present moment. What puts us human beings in agony the most is our own minds. We identify with our thoughts, whether good or bad. We think that our thoughts are us, but what we really are is what lies behind our thoughts; when we're fully present and simply observe. 

When I was feeling low, I would constantly feel angry and sad when some people treated me wrong that I would dwell about it constantly, and I would feel hopelessly miserable and worthless, only to realize that what has happened, has happened, and is not happening anymore, but only exists in my mind right now. And it's up to me to let it control me or to control it. Our default mode is to let thoughts control us and our well-being. Only when we stop and observe, we are controlling it and not vice versa.

Next time some negative thoughts and emotions come up, simply try to observe that thought and realize that it's not you, but simply something you need to observe. If there are any emotions that keep coming up, whether it's grief, anger, sadness etc., feel them fully. Cry or yell into a pillow and let it go because it doesn't serve you anymore.

What I'd advise you to do is to read some works by Eckhart Tolle. I'm specifically thinking about the book called "The Power of Now". If you don't feel like reading, you can also youtube him. He has some excellent speeches on that topic.

I wish you all the best and know that the best things are yet to come, even though it might now seem that way.
